text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown—a defensible 0–100 estimate isn’t possible from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias; neither would an all-men panel be. Your qualifications justify asking how the criteria were applied, but publication counts and PhD status may not capture teaching quality, relevant industry experience, or departmental needs.

Follow up now requesting the selection criteria, your assessment, feedback, and the expected response date. If a completed PhD was mandatory, specifically ask how that requirement was applied.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—such as sex-based comments or inconsistent application of criteria—not merely because of the panel’s composition. Check local complaint deadlines while awaiting a response.
